landing.lede: CardSwap is where you keep your collection, list cards you'd sell or trade, and message the collectors who have the card you're looking for.

steps.p: Add cards you own from an EN & JP catalog, photograph the real copy, organise binders.
Search by name, Pokémon, set, number or user. Filter by condition, language, price and city.
Message owners directly, share cards in chat, and arrange the deal your own way.

dashboard.wishlist_available: Cards from your wishlist are listed
dashboard.step_list: List a card for sale or trade
dashboard.step_wish: Add a card to your wishlist
